en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a stone monument or obelisk in front of a large building with classical architectural elements such as a gabled roof and columns. The monument includes a decorative element resembling a carved sunburst or medallion. In the foreground, there are ornamental stone urns on pedestals and a short flight of stairs. The edges of the postcard are scalloped, and the top right bears the printed or stamped text 'GULBENE.'
